sentences.en: The company paid out a small dividend this quarter.
sentences.zh: 这家公司这个季度发了小额红利。

sentences.en: Investing in stocks can be rewarding, as you receive dividends from your investments.
sentences.zh: 投资股票可能是值得的，因为你可以从投资中获得股息。

sentences.en: The dividend was calculated based on the number of shares owned.
sentences.zh: 红利是根据持有的股份数量来计算的。

senses.zh: 红利，股息，利息，（破产时清算的）分配金,,数被除数 opp. divisor,（足球彩票的）彩金
